_why: The questions a new embedding model's relevance floor is measured with (calibrate_relevance_floor in graphrag_server.py): twelve this project's corpus answers, twelve it cannot. Kept in JSON because the walk does not index JSON -- anywhere the corpus reads, the unanswerable questions would be answered by their own text and leave no gap to put a floor in. Checked against all-MiniLM-L6-v2 on this corpus on 2026-09-12: answered 0.503-0.715, unanswerable 0.156-0.369, with RETRIEVAL_RELEVANCE_FLOOR inside the gap.
